---

**`FieldOccupant.java`** (new)
A single interface with a nested `Layer` enum (`ANIMAL`, `PLANT`) and one method `getOccupantLayer()`. Introduces the contract without carrying any field-interaction logic itself.

**`Field.java`**

- Removed `placeAnimal`, `placePlant`, `clear(Location)`, `clearPlant` — they were only ever called from `Animal`/`Plant` boilerplate that no longer exists.

- Declares `implements FieldOccupant` (so `getOccupantLayer()` becomes abstract here automatically).
- Drops the two abstract methods `placeInField`/`clearFromField` entirely.
- `setLocation()` and `setDead()` now call `field.place(this, …)` / `field.removeOccupant(this, …)` — no subclass involvement.

**`Animal.java`** / **`Plant.java`**
Each now implements exactly one method: `getOccupantLayer()` returning `ANIMAL` or `PLANT`. This is pure data — no field interaction code, no grid knowledge. Concrete species (`Bear`, `Wolf`, `Grass`, `Flower`, etc.) implement nothing.
